respuesta.pregunta: In demand-forecast-docs latest, where do the ingest classes live in the project? I want to import IngestMarketplaceData in a notebook and I'm not sure if the package is app or marketplace.
respuesta.respuesta: The documentation contradicts itself here. The overview gives the ingest classes' location as `src/app/pipes/ingest` [demand-forecast-docs/latest/guide/overview.md:L279-L279]. But the notebook examples on the same page import them from the `marketplace` package: `from marketplace.pipes.ingest.ingest_timeseries import IngestMarketplaceData` [demand-forecast-docs/latest/guide/overview.md:L839-L839], `from marketplace.pipes.ingest.holidays_and_campaigns import HolidaysDatasetPipe` [demand-forecast-docs/latest/guide/overview.md:L872-L872] and `from marketplace.pipes.ingest import HolidaysDatasetPipe, IngestMarketplaceData` [demand-forecast-docs/latest/guide/overview.md:L888-L888]. One passage says the package is `app` and the code examples use `marketplace`. With this documentation alone, I can't confirm which one matches the current code.
answer_checks: Calls the tool with software demand-forecast-docs and version latest.
Cites the overview line that places the ingest classes at src/app/pipes/ingest.
Cites at least one notebook example that imports the ingest classes from marketplace.pipes.ingest.
Explains that the two disagree and does not present either app or marketplace as the confirmed package.
